PSYNC.Title: Pallor Sync
PSYNC.AutoHint: Push, pull and link everything that has changed on one side only. Conflicts stay for you to decide.
PSYNC.NoPlan: Press Rescan to compare this world with the shared compendium.
PSYNC.IgnoreHint: Ignore this shared document in this world
PSYNC.Action.available: In shared, not in this world
PSYNC.ActionHint.conflict: Both this world and the shared copy changed since the last sync. Pick which version wins for each.
PSYNC.ActionHint.push: Changed or new in this world. Applying writes them to the shared compendium.
PSYNC.ActionHint.pull: Changed or new in the shared compendium. Applying updates or creates them here.
PSYNC.ActionHint.link: Same name and identical content on both sides but not linked yet. Applying links them.
PSYNC.ActionHint.available: Shared documents this world never imported. Tick the ones to pull in, or ignore them.
PSYNC.ActionHint.ignored: Hidden from the pull list. Click the eye to bring one back.
PSYNC.Warn.LocalAssets: Uses files from this world's own folder, which the other world cannot see: {paths}. Move them to the shared assets library first.
PSYNC.Problem.NoPack: No shared compendium is configured for {type} ({n} shared document(s) waiting). Add a {type} pack to the Forge shared compendium, then pick it under Shared packs.
PSYNC.Problem.Locked: The pack "{pack}" is locked. Unlock it in the Compendium sidebar.
PSYNC.Packs.Title: Shared packs
PSYNC.Packs.Hint: Which compendium pack holds the shared copy of each document type.
PSYNC.Packs.Explain: Pick one unlocked compendium per document type. "Automatic" uses the first Forge shared compendium pack of that type.
PSYNC.Picker.Title: Share documents
PSYNC.Picker.Hint: Ticked documents are marked as shared and pushed on the next sync. Anything inside a folder named in the Shared folders setting is shared automatically.
PSYNC.Context.UnshareConfirm: Also delete the shared copy of "{name}" from the compendium? (No keeps it there for the other world.)
PSYNC.Session.Title: Session recorder
PSYNC.Session.EndConfirm: End the current session? Its Markdown summary is copied to the clipboard and stays in the Pallor Session Log journal for Claude to file in the vault.
PSYNC.Settings.SharedFolders.Name: Shared folders
PSYNC.Settings.SharedFolders.Hint: Comma-separated folder names. Every document inside a folder with one of these names (or its subfolders) is shared automatically.
PSYNC.Settings.ScanOnReady.Name: Scan when the world starts
PSYNC.Settings.ScanOnReady.Hint: Compare shared content with the shared compendium a few seconds after the GM logs in.
PSYNC.Settings.OpenOnChanges.Name: Open the window when something changed
PSYNC.Settings.OpenOnChanges.Hint: After the startup scan, open Pallor Sync if there is anything to push, pull or resolve.
PSYNC.Settings.AutoApply.Name: Apply safe changes automatically at startup
PSYNC.Settings.AutoApply.Hint: Push, pull and link one-sided changes without asking. Conflicts always wait for you.
PSYNC.Settings.LogEnabled.Name: Record sessions
PSYNC.Settings.LogEnabled.Hint: The active GM client writes chat, rolls, HP, XP, loot, conditions, combat, scene and time changes into the Pallor Session Log journal.
PSYNC.Settings.AutoStart.Name: Start a session automatically
PSYNC.Settings.AutoStart.Hint: When the GM logs in and no session is running, start a new one named after today's date.
PSYNC.Settings.Menu.Hint: Compare this world with the shared compendium, push and pull changes, manage the session recorder.
PSYNC.Notify.GMOnly: Only the GM can use Pallor Sync.
PSYNC.Notify.NoteSaved: Note added to the session log.
PSYNC.Notify.Copied: Session Markdown copied to the clipboard.
PSYNC.Notify.SessionEnded: Session ended: {n} events recorded, Markdown copied to the clipboard.
